"""A robot"""
type Robot implements Node @key(fields: "id") {
  id: ID!
  name: String
  pos: [Int!]!
  move(cmds: String = "A", dirs: [Dir!]): Robot
}
interface Node { id: ID! }
enum Dir { NORTH EAST }
input RobotInput { name: String! }
union Thing = Robot
type Query { robot(id: ID!): Robot }
extend type Query { all: [Robot!]! }
schema { query: Query }
fragment F on Robot { id ...on Robot { name } }
query Q($id: ID! = "1") @cached { robot(id: $id) { ...F } }
